name: paper-agent
title: Paper Agent
description: Ask questions about research papers. Select text anywhere → hotkey → ask → streamed answers from your paper vault.
author: paper-agent

commands.name: capture-and-ask
commands.title: Capture & Ask Paper Agent
commands.subtitle: Capture selection → ask
commands.description: Select text in any app, invoke this command via hotkey. It captures your selection fresh every time and opens the ask form.

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask Paper Agent
commands.subtitle: Ask a question about selected text
commands.description: Select text in any app, invoke this command, pick a space, type a question, and get a streamed answer from the daemon.

commands.name: session-history
commands.title: Paper Agent Sessions
commands.subtitle: Browse past Q&A sessions
commands.description: Browse your session history from the paper vault.

commands.name: end-paper
commands.title: End Paper
commands.subtitle: Generate Q&A insight summary
commands.description: Finished reading a paper? Generate a summary of insights from your Q&A history. Requires at least 5 Q&A sessions for the paper.

preferences.name: daemonUrl
preferences.title: Daemon URL
preferences.description: URL of the paper-agent daemon (e.g. http://localhost:8765)

preferences.name: defaultSpace
preferences.title: Default Space
preferences.description: Fallback space if no context or previous space is available
